Detailed Description

template<BinaryOpFunction op>
class BinaryOpUGenT< op >

A binary operator UGen using a template for the processing function.

Any function which has the appropriate declaration can be uses as the template parameter. E.g., 

  float myfunc(float a, float b)
  {
    return a + b; // return the sum of the two inputs
  }
Template Parameters:
opThis must be the name of a function that takes two float arguments and returns a float.
